name: accremind-monorepo
description: AccreMind - a local-first knowledge base for AI-assisted engineering: Markdown as the source of truth, a rebuildable local index, and three budgeted injection layers, delivered through a CLI, a standalone workbench and a DeepSeek Harness plugin

scripts.verify: node scripts/build.ts && node --test tests/*.test.ts && node scripts/check-webui.ts
scripts.typecheck:kernel: pnpm --filter @accremind/webui exec tsc --noEmit -p ../core/tsconfig.json --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --types node && pnpm --filter @accremind/webui exec tsc --noEmit -p ../dsh-plugin/tsconfig.json --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --types node
